name: virtual-dom
description: A lightweight Virtual DOM and reconciliation engine in pure JavaScript. Features virtual node creation (h/createElement), tree diffing & patch reconciliation, functional components with state and effect hooks (useState, useEffect), and server-side rendering (SSR) to HTML.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a micro-frontend rendering frame or custom Virtual DOM engine with component states/hooks and server-side rendering capabilities in environments with zero dependencies.
